newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 10.5 trln rbls bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 10.5 trln rbls bills, bonds.

text.p: The Russian Finance Ministry will auction 6.50 trillion roubles of 308-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22085) and 4.00 trillion roubles of 728-day bonds (series 24013) on May 28, the Central Bank said on Wednesday.
Full details of the auctions follow:
On May 28 the Finance Ministry will also repay 2.60 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of 91-day T-bills (series 21072).
It will also repay 3.29 trillion roubles on a maturing 18-month OFZ interest-bearing government bond (series 24004) plus 209 billion roubles in interest on the bond.
